# Getting help

Atlas Todo is a spare-time project with one maintainer. Please pick the right place, so the
answer helps the next person too:

| You have                                          | Go to                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A question about using the app                    | [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas-todo/discussions/categories/q-a)                                                     |
| Trouble setting up your own server                | [the core repository's Discussions](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/discussions) (the server, its image and its NixOS module live there) |
| An idea or a wish                                 | [Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas-todo/discussions/categories/ideas)                                                 |
| A bug in the app, or a well-defined feature       | [an issue](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas-todo/issues/new/choose)                                                                       |
| A bug in the server, the image or the `atlas` CLI | [an issue in the core repository](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/issues/new/choose)                                                     |
| A security problem                                | [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md): privately, never in a public issue                                                                           |
| A problem with a server someone else runs         | that server's admin (the app's _Report a problem_ screen reaches them, not this project)                                                    |

Before asking, the [self-hosting guide](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md)
covers settings, reverse proxies, backups and upgrades, and
[the roadmap](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) says what is planned and
what is not.

## What to expect

- Issues and discussions are read and triaged about once a week. If nothing happened on your pull
  request after 7 days, comment on it to ping.
- Security reports are acknowledged within 7 days ([SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md#what-happens-next)).
- Only the latest release gets fixes. Please check a bug against it before reporting.
- Releases ship when they are ready, with no fixed schedule.
- Requests that don't fit [the roadmap](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)
  may be declined, with the reason. The
  [design decisions](https://github.com/atlastodo/atlas/tree/main/docs/decisions) explain the
  bigger ones.
- There is no paid support or uptime guarantee, including for the test server at
  app.atlastodo.dev.
